summary: Collective Mining Ltd., a Canadian gold-silver explorer listed in the US, furnished a Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, together with interim MD&A and CEO/CFO certifications under Canadian Form 52-109F2. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation or advisor is stated. Cash fell to $70.6 million from $129.6 million as exploration spending escalated; the net loss widened to $55.9 million. This is a routine periodic reporting filing, not a special situation; watch treasury burn and warrant revaluation, not deal terms.
